driven_run.description: One live root-scope launch through the wired hook row: the real installed client was invoked against a loopback recorder, so the vendor API was never contacted.

findings.finding: The complete 4211-byte serialized JCS envelope reaches the model input byte-exactly and exactly once through the gate.
A resumed session replays its own transcript, so the envelope stays visible once; the gate writes no second claim and injects no second copy.
A --settings hook merges with the project settings layer instead of replacing it, so any additionalContext event already registered there is a second injection authority the launcher does not own.

A refused gate produced zero model-input requests: the unowned session, the oversize payload, and the drifted envelope each blocked the prompt before any model input existed, so no user task ran without its context.
Registering this gate on SessionStart delivers nothing and claims nothing, so even a misconfigured launcher cannot turn it into a second authority.
Narrowing --setting-sources to user suppresses the project memory the Step 12.2 native evidence enumerated, so the canonical launch keeps the default sources and adds only its own hook.
The client's 10000/10001 boundary holds through this registration path; at 10001 it substitutes a <persisted-output> preview plus a temporary-file pointer, which is never delivery.

gate.exactly_once: atomic no-replace creation of the per-generation claim; a repeated prompt in the same generation is answered with no additionalContext
gate.failure_behavior: no claim is written, so the launcher's own post-run claim check fails closed independently of the client's exit status
gate.registration: one launcher-owned --settings file written into the kernel's owner-only runtime session; no workspace, project, or user settings file is ever modified

injection_authority.compaction: unsupported and fail-closed; the frozen rows record compact_supported false
injection_authority.foreign_authority: any SessionStart or UserPromptSubmit hook registered in the project, local, or user settings layer makes both rows ineligible with E_CHANNEL
injection_authority.full_content_row: --append-system-prompt; the launcher registers no hook at all
injection_authority.hook_row: the launcher's own --settings UserPromptSubmit gate; no --append-system-prompt argument is passed
injection_authority.resume: validates and continues one generation; the claim prevents a second copy
injection_authority.rule: exactly one pre-task injection authority per launcher-controlled generation
injection_authority.session_start: never registered by the launcher and refused by the gate
